metadata.title: MedOrbits Courses Database
metadata.description: Courses referenced by exams and admission records, including healthcare, allied-health, science, engineering, business, law, design and other study pathways.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify course details (duration, regulator, eligibility, admission route and recognition) against current official sources before publication. Never invent details. Broad discovery entries must not be presented as specific approved qualifications.

dataRules: id and slug must be unique across all courses; slug must be lowercase kebab-case.
countryCode must be an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or null for courses not tied to one country.
Every value in examIds must reference an existing exam record, and that exam's courseIds should include this course.
examIds may be empty when admission is not through a national exam or the exam has not yet been verified.
durationYears, regulatorName, regulatorUrl and sourceUrl must be null until verified from an official source.
regulatorUrl must be HTTPS and point to the authoritative regulator.
verifiedAt and verifiedBy must be null until actually verified, and set together.
verificationStatus 'verified' requires verifiedAt, verifiedBy and sourceUrl.
Listing a course here does not mean admissions are open; the active field controls display only.
Never invent durations, eligibility, regulators or links.
Each course must use one of the declared level, discipline and verificationStatus values.
Broad discovery categories must be clearly distinguished from exact degree or diploma titles.
Do not infer exam eligibility from course names; confirm exam-to-course relationships against current official notices.
Course records should be deactivated or marked outdated when current official information cannot be maintained.
A non-empty examIds array must be reconciled with the project's exams database before deployment.
